scenarios.name: normal_heating_in_winter
scenarios.description: Reference vector: heating valve at 40% with OAT 2 °C — below the heating lockout, so heating is legitimate

scenarios.name: heating_when_warm
scenarios.description: Reference vector: heating valve at 30% with OAT 25 °C — heating lockout is not active; alarms after alarm_delay (1800 s)

scenarios.name: cooling_when_cold
scenarios.description: Reference vector: cooling valve at 40% with OAT 2 °C — cooling lockout is not active; alarms after alarm_delay

scenarios.name: normal_cooling_in_summer
scenarios.description: Cooling valve at 60% with OAT 28 °C — above the cooling lockout, so cooling is legitimate

scenarios.name: valve_exactly_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Edge case: heating valve sits exactly at valve_open_threshold (5%) in 25 °C weather — the strict `>` means the coil does not count as open

scenarios.name: oat_at_heating_lockout_then_above
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAT sits exactly at heating_lockout_temp (18 °C) with the heating valve open — no alarm; at t=1200 OAT rises to 18.1 °C and the alarm follows 1800 s later

scenarios.name: oat_at_cooling_lockout
scenarios.description: Edge case: OAT sits exactly at cooling_lockout_temp (10 °C) with the cooling valve open — the strict `<` means no alarm

scenarios.name: warm_spell_clears_before_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: heating runs in 25 °C air, but OAT drops back to 5 °C at t=1200 — the condition clears before alarm_delay completes, so no alarm

scenarios.name: valve_cycle_resets_persistence
scenarios.description: Transient: cooling valve closes at t=900 and reopens at t=1200 in 2 °C air — persistence restarts from the reopen, so the alarm lands at 3000 s, not 1800 s
